prompt: Objective: assess whether the plant-based meat industry is attractive. What you've learned: sales grew fast until 2021 and have fallen since. Latest finding: repeat purchase rates are low. What is the best next step?

options.text: Re-check the sales trend in more detail
options.feedback: That has already been answered. Build on what you know.

options.text: Look at the founders' social media for more context on the business
options.feedback: That is off the objective. It won't help answer the client's question.

options.text: Find out why buyers don't come back
options.feedback: Right. Low repeat purchases explain the decline, so the next step is why buyers don't return.

options.text: Conclude that the industry is dead
options.feedback: That jumps to a solution before the analysis supports it.

explanation: Low repeat purchases explain the decline, so the next step is why buyers don't return.
